flagged.evidence: Proof 6.1 says that the “σ₀-copies are exactly the lines spanned by nonzero vectors fixed by π(F) ... so by step 5.1 the range ... [is] exactly the fixed space.” The cited definition gives Hσ₀ as the *closed* span of those copies. Identifying that closure with the fixed-vector space requires showing the latter is closed, which this step omits. It is an immediate gap: the fixed space is ⋂_{g∈F} ker(π(g)−I), closed since each π(g) is bounded.
